summary: New admins are linked to their company and department at once, and setup scripts sign in more reliably.

fixes.title: New admins are linked at once
fixes.text: A new consultant admin is linked at once to its external company and internal department, and an internal admin to its department.

fixes.title: Mail-sender setup no longer fails
fixes.text: The mail-sender setup reuses what is already in place instead of failing.

fixes.title: Setup sign-in works in more cases
fixes.text: Browser sign-in in the setup scripts works when your PC uses IPv6 for localhost, and an Azure Arc or VM machine identity no longer blocks it.
